analyticalMisses.summary: CLE F5 was a strong winner (+32.47) while CLE 5+ runs failed -- side strength does not imply the run threshold clears.
CIN F5 was a loss and also killed the four-leg parlay -- one thesis failing cost twice.

analyticalWins.summary: Strong day overall: 8-5, +77.64 exact cash. F5 sides went 4-2 and were materially profitable (+58.56 on $170 rounded risk).
TB showed a full-game moneyline can outperform the same team's total when the offensive threshold fails: TB ML +11.37 while TB 5+ runs lost.
WSH F5 and WSH 5+ runs both succeeded -- side and threshold agreeing is the favorable case for pairing them.
CHC F5 and CHC 5+ runs both succeeded (+48.92 combined).
Team totals went 3-2 and were profitable (+17.69 on $75).

gameLevelConcentration.note: Three TB positions: F5 +26.15, ML +11.37, TT -10. Net +27.52 -- the ML/TT split is the instructive part, not the concentration.
CLE F5 +32.47 and both CLE parlay legs won, but CLE 5+ runs lost -$15.
CHC F5 +32.47 and CHC 5+ +16.45 both won -- side and threshold agreed.

performanceByMarketFamily.note: F5 sides: TB, WSH, CLE, CHC won; BOS and CIN lost. Materially profitable and the day's main driver.
BOS 4+, WSH 5+, CHC 5+ won; TB 5+ and CLE 5+ lost.
TB ML won (exact cost 14.99) while TB 5+ runs lost -- ML outperformed TT on the same game.
Four-leg parlay lost: PHI ML and CIN F5 legs failed (CLE F5 and CLE ML legs won).
